messages.subject: useR! 2021
messages.body_plain:
Dear GSoC mentors,

Please consider encouraging your GSoC students to attend useR! 2021 (https://user2021.r-project.org/). Since the conference is online this year, it is a great opportunity for everyone to learn more about R and network with R users/developers.

Registration fees are adjusted by country of residence, but GSoC students should feel free to ask for a fee waiver, see the FAQ: https://user2021.r-project.org/participation/faq/#waiver.

Of course, I hope you will also consider attending yourselves, if you're not already registered!

Best wishes,

Heather
